changelog:
- Initial release of stock-roundtable.
- Provides a structured, debate-oriented framework for stock analysis, emphasizing transparent argument and evidence gathering.
- Supports common use-cases: stock/ETF buy-sell-hold questions, post-earnings analysis, risk/valuation questions, head-to-head comparisons.
- Insists on real-time data verification; refuses service if no internet access.
- Final output includes evidence-based conclusions, strongest arguments from both sides, risk points, action conditions, and recommended metrics to track.
